Hi Dylan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our launch target for the patient triage assistant is Oct 12 and we want Redwood to help with ongoing quality monitoring so we can detect regressions early and run safe rollbacks if needed. Attached is a first pass at the prompt sets we use in prod and a short list of business-critical intents. Can you confirm the next steps to integrate the eval harness and what success criteria we should monitor during canary?

- Validate our prompt set (rivermed_prompt_sets_v1.csv) and suggest any coverage gaps
- Integrate eval harness so we can run nightly regression checks against a baseline

Availability for a 45-min alignment this week: Wed 9/9 10–12 PT or Thu 9/10 9–11 PT.

Attachments: rivermed_prompt_sets_v1.csv (csv, 14KB)

Best,
Alex Park

Alex — thanks for the prompt sets and clear asks. We're aligned on scope. Proposed next steps below and a checklist to bring into the kickoff: 

1) Quick review (today): Marissa to run a coverage pass on prompt sets and flag any missing edge intents.
2) Eval harness integration (this week): Karthik/Monica will share a minimal integration guide and example job config. We recommend running nightly batch evaluations against your stable baseline (v1.0).
3) Canary plan (pre-launch): define metrics (intent accuracy, hallucination rate, median token latency), set canary buckets (5% -> 25% -> 100%) and rollback triggers (e.g., 5% relative drop in normalized intent score or a sustained spike in hallucination alerts for 30 minutes).

I attached the eval harness integration guide and a canary policy template to keep things concrete. Can you confirm Wed 9/9 10:30 PT for the 45-min alignment? If that works we'll share a short mutual action plan (MAP) and who owns each artifact.

Attachments: eval_harness_integration_guide.pdf (pdf, 220KB), canary_policy_template.md (text, 6KB)

Thanks —

Internal notes / engineering starter checklist (Monica):

- Prompt sets: initial pass looks ok; add ~30 negative examples for hallucination checks and 20 edge-case phrasings for intent disambiguation. I'll push an annotated copy to the Drive link.
- Eval harness: we'll provide a dockerized runner + sample YAML for nightly jobs. Needs a small webhook from Rivermed to push new model version metadata (model_id, commit hash, rolling label).
- Canary thresholds (proposal):
  * Intent accuracy delta > 4% (relative) sustained for 3 consecutive evaluation windows -> warn
  * Intent accuracy delta > 7% (relative) OR hallucination rate > 2% absolute -> trigger rollback
  * Latency: p95 increase > 40% -> auto-fallback to smaller quantized variant
- Rollback mechanics: we prefer automated policy that flips traffic to previous stable variant and notifies stakeholders; include a manual override in the first two canary phases.

I'll prepare the annotated prompt set and the initial validator scripts today. Karthik — can you add the sample job config with expected output schema?

-Monica

Thanks Monica — adding technical details for the integration and rollout cadence: 

- Eval harness outputs: JSONL with fields (example_id, prompt_variant, baseline_score, current_score, hallucination_flag, metadata.tags). We'll store nightly artifacts under the deal folder and wire an alert when aggregated metrics exceed thresholds.
- Canary rollout schedule (recommended): 3-phase ramp over 48 hours: 5% for 6 hours (monitor), 25% for 18 hours (monitor + extended checks), 100% after 24 hours stable. Each phase has a 30-minute cool-down window before advancing.
- Backstop rollback: if rollback triggers we will immediately re-route to previous stable variant and execute a short forensic eval run; we will include an incident runbook link in the alert payload.

I'll draft the sample job config and a minimal Lambda/webhook snippet to capture model metadata and trigger nightly runs. Will post to the Drive and ping the thread when ready.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
